newsitem.title: USA: American Phoenix to acquire Tetherless.
newsitem.headline: American Phoenix to acquire Tetherless.

text.p: American Phoenix Group Inc said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Tetherless Access Asia Ltd, a provider of wireless data network services based in Melbourne, Australia.
Following the deal, Tetherless Access shareholders would own about 60 percent of American Phoenix's fully diluted shares and would be able to choose a majority of its board.

American Phoenix also set a one-for-two reverse stock split of its common shares and plans to distribute one common stock purchase warrant as a dividend for every four shares of common held on the as-yet-undetermined record date.
After the split, American Phoenix would pay Tetherless Access 2.0 million common shares and 8.0 million shares of convertible preferred stock.
The preferred would convert to 24.0 million common shares in four equal blocks of 6.0 million shares after two, four, five and six years, respectively, American Phoenix said.

Tetherless Access, a privately held company, provides wireless data networking services in developing countries. To date, it has invested over $10 million in developing networking systems, acquiring distribution rights, entering joint ventures and building an international management team.
